== Published English Original Virtual Set 6 wording ==
The December 2003 interim text and January 2004 slip impose the loss whenever a Jedi is lost. The remastered text narrows that trigger to a Jedi lost by the opponent. Both keep the opposing battle loss, immunity reduction, permanent-weapon restriction and draw-phase upkeep.
